Name: Crosshair Cursors
Author: ApollyonSV
Description:
[center][size=6][u][b]﻿About This Mod[/b][/u][/size]

[size=3]This mod will allow you to change the default cursor with a crosshair. There are currently 16 crosshairs and 8 colors to choose from giving a total of 128 different combinations! May add more in the future if the reception for this mod is good. [/size][i][size=3]The crosshair cursors do not perfectly center up with where the default cursor points. For this reason, I have added a border to the top left of each crosshair to reference where the original cursor would be pointing to. [/size]

[/i][size=3]I'll probably update the slingshot crosshairs at some point to accurately reflect on the chosen crosshair[/size]

[u][size=6][b]Installation[/b]
[/size][/u]
[size=3]- Download and install[/size][b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Pathoschild's Content Patcher[/url][b]﻿ [/b][size=3]if you don't have it already[/size]
[size=3]- Download[/size][b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3]. I highly recommend this as it will make configuring the in game changes a whole lot easier[/size]
[size=3]- Download Crosshair Cursors[/size]
[size=3]- Unpack the contents of the archive to your .../StardewValley/Mods folder using a program such as WinRAR[/size]

[size=3]*If you have the Generic Mod Config Menu downloaded, just click on the lower left cog button on the main menu screen, find Crosshair Cursors, and make changes there. Don't forget to save and close! [/size][i]These changes will NOT happen immediately. I recommend looking at the chart below and once you've picked out a cursor you like, set it in Generic Mod Config Menu and load your save. [/i][size=3]If you find yourself wanting to change the cursor multiple times, I suggest adding a keybind to open up Generic Mod Config Menu while in game, changing the cursor, and running through the nearest loading zone (such as going inside your house or leaving/entering town) as this will make the changes happen immediately without having to relaunch your game or go back to the main menu and reload your save.[/size]


[size=3]Launch the game and enjoy![/size]
